typeHints.trunk: Dialed numbers that start with a prefix are sent out, with the prefix rewritten.
typeHints.dst: Calls arriving on this number are routed to a destination.
typeHints.src: Calls from this caller number are routed to a destination.
typeHints.userLogin: A code the agent dials to log in, e.g. *40 followed by the user.
typeHints.userLogout: A code the agent dials to log out.
typeHints.userAvailable: A code the agent dials to become available.
typeHints.userBreak: A code the agent dials to go on break.
typeHints.userLoggedOut: A code the agent dials to set logged out.
typeHints.spy: A code followed by a device, to listen in on its call.
typeHints.pickup: A code that picks up a call ringing in the group.
typeHints.pickupExtension: A code followed by a device, to pick up its ringing call.
typeHints.followMe: A code followed by a number, to forward this device to it.
typeHints.followMeDisable: A code that turns call forwarding off.
typeHints.callerIdReplace: A code followed by a number, dialed with a replaced caller ID.

create.title: Create a new Route
create.desc: Set up a new phone number (Route) and configure how incoming calls are routed. Fill in the details below, then choose a bridge to handle calls.

edit.title: Edit Route
edit.desc: Update the settings for this phone number. You can change the name, routing, and metadata.

create.title: Create IVR
create.desc: Build an interactive voice menu. Callers will hear an announcement and press keys to reach different destinations.

edit.title: Edit IVR
edit.desc: Modify this voice menu — update the announcement, timeout, or entry routing.

create.title: Create Queue
create.desc: Set up a call queue. Incoming calls will be distributed to agents based on the strategy you choose.

edit.title: Edit Queue
edit.desc: Update this queue's agents, strategy, or hold announcements.

create.title: Create Announcement
create.desc: Record or upload an audio announcement that can be used in IVRs, queues, or as a standalone destination.

edit.title: Edit Announcement
edit.desc: Update this announcement's audio file or settings.

create.title: Create VML Script
create.desc: Write a VoiceML script for advanced call flow logic.

create.title: Create Call Condition
create.desc: Define time-based or conditional routing rules. Calls are routed differently based on the conditions you set.

edit.title: Edit Call Condition
edit.desc: Update the conditions and routing for this call condition.

create.title: Create Bot
create.desc: Set up an AI bot to handle incoming calls with automated responses.

edit.title: Edit Bot
edit.desc: Update this bot's configuration and behavior.

create.title: Create Device
create.desc: Add a new SIP device for a user.

edit.title: Edit Device
edit.desc: Update this device's credentials and settings.
